thread:
sam: Heads-up — canary traces show a 2-3x p50/p99 increase on the paged+Flash path after the kernel-selector heuristic change (merged in 0f9a1c3). Repro on prod-ish cluster: sequence_length=1024, batch_size>=16. microbench attached.

anya: Oof. Commit 0f9a1c3 is the 'prefer-fused-over-paged' logic right? Can you paste the bench command you ran?

sam: `bench/attn_kernels.py --model=gpt2 --seq=1024 --batch=16 --variants=auto,fused_flash_v2,paged_flash` got:
- auto: 48 ms p50 / 180 ms p99
- fused_flash_v2: 60 ms p50 / 350 ms p99
- paged_flash: 20 ms p50 / 60 ms p99

jordan: perf-bot alerted too: https://perf/reports/1714123456 (flamegraph attached). Looks like hotspot in fused_flash_v2 kernel with divergent memory access and a big stall at KV cache loads.

matt: Could be KV prefetch + fused kernel bad interaction. Fused doesn't tolerate non-contiguous KV layout, and our prefetch stride changed in the same PR earlier. @sam can you repro with KV cache disabled?

sam: repro with `--kv-prefetch=off` yields auto: 22 / 65, fused_flash_v2: 25 / 70, paged 20 / 60 — so prefetched KV seems to be the multiplier.

anya: Nice minimal repro. That narrows it to prefetch + fused path.

perf-bot: regression-detector: Regression detected in eng-runtime on canary: metric=attn_tail_p99, delta=+230%, suspect=0f9a1c3. Starting bisect run.

jordan: I ran `nvprof` and `nsys`: kernel occupancy drops to 40% for fused_flash_v2 on seq=1024; memory warp efficiency is 54% vs 92% for paged. Looks like bank conflicts when prefetch populates KV pages out-of-order.

matt: Theory: our prefetch stride changed from contiguous page chunks to alternate-chunk order to reduce network jitter; fused kernel assumed contiguous KV in L2 and now suffers.

sam: Quick experiment: revert prefetch ordering (local patch) -> fused_flash_v2 p99 back to ~70ms, auto picks fused and overall p99 ~75ms.

anya: So root cause is interaction, not fused kernel itself. For short-term: patch selector to prefer paged if kv_prefetch != contiguous for seq>512 OR add a fast path to fused to handle strided KV loads.

sam: I'll push a small selector patch: `if kv_prefetch_mode != contiguous and seq_len >= 512: prefer paged_flash` and run canary.

perf-bot: deploy-trigger: rolling canary of eng-runtime@sam/selector-hotfix started.

matt: Also file a follow-up task to add fused kernel strided-load handling + unit test.

jordan: Recording perf artifacts in the incident ticket #6421. Attaching before/after microbench CSVs.

sam: Canary numbers after hotfix: auto: 21 / 68, paged: 19 / 62, fused: 23 / 75. p99 improved across the board. Rolling to prod next hour unless objections.

anya: :thumbsup: good catch. Please include the minimal repro script in the PR and mark as release-blocker for next runtime patch.

sam: Will do. PR: https://git/repo/pull/987 (includes benchmarks + reasoning). Closing the triage — follow-ups: FN-321 add fused strided support, FN-322 e2e regression test for kv-prefetch modes.

ops-bot: Note: scheduled prod rollout at 2024-05-10T15:10Z.

jordan: Thanks everyone, great teamwork. If perf dips again ping me and I'll re-run bisect.
